provenance.source: Never measured on this camera. It is the value the pipeline has always used for any camera whose name contains ZWO (CAMERA_CEILING_ADU in pipelines/stacking/exposure_saturation.py), kept so that behaviour does not change.
Pipeline default: just under the 16-bit maximum of 65535, applied to every camera. See measure_saturated_pixel_fraction in pipelines/shared/quality/quality_metrics.py.

notes: The alias ZWO CCD ASI120MC-S follows the way the ASI533's FITS header spells its name. It has not been seen in a real ASI120MC-S header.
